title: Bar Salts Dragonfruit Raspberry Grape 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vampire Vape
description: Vampire Vape Bar Salts Dragonfruit Raspberry Grape combines the exotic and sweet notes of Dragonfruit with the tangy burst of Raspberry and the rich, juicy flavour of Grape. This layered and refreshing blend delivers a bold and vibrant vaping experience, perfect for fans of unique and tropical fruit e-liquids. Crafted with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Vampire Vape Bar Salts deliver the ideal balance of flavour and vapour, making them well-suited for Mouth-To-Lung (MTL) devices like starter kits and pod kits. The nicotine salt formulation ensures smooth throat hits and quick nicotine relief, offering the same bold, concentrated flavours vapers enjoy from disposable vape bars. As a more sustainable vaping alternative to single-use disposable vape bars, Bar Salts e-liquids are available in a 10ml format, providing a longer-lasting and less wasteful option for use with reusable vape devices. Available in 0mg, 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg nicotine strengths, Dragonfruit Raspberry Grape is a versatile and flavour-packed choice for adult smokers and vapers.
